text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text: Do you believe in destiny? I know it.

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
I feel a sense of destiny with Vodka. A 
comfortable... special bond. Probably 
because she's so straightforward.

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
The only way to answer someone's 
admiration is with your absolute best run. 
That's what it means to be a senior, 
right?
